one_liner: Neo4j offers the Aura management REST API (OAuth2 client credentials) plus per-database HTTP Query API (Basic/Bearer) and an official MCP server; the free Aura tier allows self-serve testing.
auth_notes: Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials (client ID/secret to bearer token), which is not a user-authorization flow. The database HTTP/Query API uses Basic auth with database username and password, and also supports bearer tokens. Per-database credentials are the main way to use the data API.
access_notes: Aura Free needs no credit card and gives instance credentials. The Aura management API credentials may require billing info for Free and Professional users, per the classic docs; the current docs say all tiers can create them. The database Query API works with free instance credentials.
blocker_notes: Per-instance credentials, and no multi-user OAuth authorization-code flow. The Query API is hosted per database.

evidence.quote: The Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication.
No credit card or other payment method required
All tiers can create Aura API credentials.
To authenticate API requests to the [Aura API](/docs/aura/platform/api/specification/), you must provide a Bearer Token in the `Authorization` header
If you are looking for the official product Neo4j MCP server please find it [here](https://github.com/neo4j/mcp).
